title: Codex runtime adapter
description: Objective: add a capability-probed Codex provider with pinned runtime closure, structured/raw events, cancellation, and reconciliation parity. Deliverable: focused runner Codex modules plus golden streams. NOT in scope: Gemini or provider marketplace. Hard dependency: proven Claude adapter contract and Foundation effect supervisor. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/providers/codex/** and packages/testkit/src/providers/codex/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: Probe and runtime closure are immutable and every unproven capability is typed UNSUPPORTED.
Effect identity, raw events, cwd/process observation, cancellation, and crash reconciliation match the provider contract.
No provider output grants authority or satisfies verification.
taskRails: Portability consumes frozen daemon/core contracts; adapters cannot fork lifecycle or authority semantics.
Official MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP only; no custom MCP-over-WebSocket dialect.
Unsupported OS/provider/import facts remain typed UNSUPPORTED or UNKNOWN, never guessed.
IDE adapters are thin optional shells for the standalone control room. Keep files below 400 lines and use explicit owned paths.
reopenReason: Promoted by governor-eae4fc53 2026-08-09 on human instruction. NOW A CLEAN DEPENDENCY PASS — this task has been hard-blocked since the board began and its clause finally resolves. Its stated hard dependency is "proven Claude adapter contract and Foundation effect supervisor". Claude runtime adapter (task-5ff2b39d) has been DONE for some time. "Foundation effect supervisor" resolves to task-312c1de3, which I closed minutes ago on the strength of its four QA-approved SPIDR children (task-2580a578, task-4a3b5ec0, task-ba3a45f9, task-49acb856 — all DONE). ARCHITECT, TWO THINGS BEFORE YOU PLAN. (1) The supervisor is real code, not a promise: read packages/runner/src/supervisor/ on disk — effect-kernel, effect-shape, effect-parse, effect-lifecycle, effect-grant, effect-activation, lease-mirror, launch-lock, drain-reconciliation, drain-table, restart-reconstruction and their tests. Verify the symbols you intend to name; do not plan against the parent shell's description, which never described code. (2) Mirror the Claude adapter rather than inventing a shape: packages/runner/src/providers/claude/ is the proven contract this task's own description points at (claude-probe, claude-observation, claude-cancel-reconcile, claude-render, claude-stream). Owned paths are packages/runner/src/providers/codex/** and packages/testkit/src/providers/codex/**, both greenfield, so no collision with anything in flight. NOTE the runner package convention: it now HAS .js bridges (45+, added by task-eb9ff081), so unlike the original claude modules your new files DO need sibling bridges — and task-535e773b is landing a repo-wide runtime-loadability gate that will enforce it. DOWNSTREAM: this task gates task-e87a7353 (Linux effect conformance) and task-e94b2055 (macOS effect conformance), the last two hard-blocked tasks in epic-f02c6977.

comments.content: Roadmap amendment 2026-08-07: the Codex adapter must consume the same provider-neutral validated skill snapshot and canonical AGENTS.md contract as Claude, record exact rendered bytes/digest, respect scoped instruction precedence, and never let skill or prompt text grant command/effect authority.
